Commentary.Commentary: Earlier in the session, the England openers commenced from where they left but couldn't stick around for long. After that, Root did try to make things right but the 'Pandya' wind blew everything and everyone away. The home team were down to 128/9 and hence, the session was extended. In this little phase, however, Buttler changed gears and thrashed a few to drag the total to 161 and save the follow on. The Indian team should feel happier considering they have a big lead now and will look to swell it further. The pitch is still doing enough to assist the bowlers and the batters will need to show application to survive. The play starts after the break in a short while, hang around!

Blown away in a session! For the first time in this series, the Indian bowlers have shown what they can do. After the 50-run stand between the opening duo, the visitors did not allow any other pair to stitch any partnership. Their destroyer-in-chief was Hardik Pandya who got his first 5-fer of his Test career. He went through the middle order, and was nicely supported by his colleagues who were into the wickets column as well. A special mention for Rishabh Pant as he became the youngest keeper to take five catches in an innings.

OUT! That is it! Buttler holes out! However, it is an excellent cameo from him. Bumrah bangs in another short of a length delivery. Buttler tries to clear the cow corner region but gets a top edge towards long on. Shardul Thakur, the substitute there, runs in and takes a good catch. ENGLAND ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 161 and INDIA GAIN A 168-RUN LEAD!

In the air... but safe! Also couple added to the total! A good bouncer on middle, Buttler goes for the pull but the ball takes the top edge and lands in no man's land at the fine leg region and the batsmen run two. Bumrah is not happy with Shami's effort as he felt there was only a run there.
And Anderson plays it out like an expert. On the stumps, he plants his front foot forward and blocks it.
Shortish and outside off, Buttler cuts it towards covers for a run. Again Anderson has to play out just one delivery.
Driven crisply but finds the fielder at covers.
The slower ball outside off, Buttler goes for the cut but misses.
The bumper, Jos hammers it through mid-wicket but finds the fielder in the deep.
SIX! Boom boom goes Buttler! 171 is what the deficit is. This was right in his arc, full and outside off. Buttler smashes it over long off for a biggie.
Almost! The bumper on the body of the batsman. He some how fends it away from the fielder at short leg.
The session has been extended by half an hour as England are nine down.
And Buttler takes the single! Full and on middle, JB hits it down to long on and gets to the other end. That also brings up 1000 Test runs for him.
Shorter in length on off, Jos pushes it to sweeper cover and still does not take a run. 4 dots. The field is still not being brought in.
Back of a length on middle, Buttler tries to defend but gets it off the inner half towards square leg.
Good length on off, Buttler strokes it through covers and does not take the run.
On the shorter side outside off, Buttler chops it towards point.
Jasprit Bumrah is back on.
That one ball almost did the trick. Ishant Sharma comes around the wicket and bowls it on a length around off, it shapes away late. Anderson plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Works it with the angle through mid-wicket and takes one. Anderson has one ball to see off now.
OHHH! Well bowled! Buttler cleared his front leg wanting to go for the big one. Ishant goes for the yorker but it is outside leg. Buttler swings and misses.
Good length outside off, Buttler slaps it through cover-point and some good running helps them take two.
Down the leg side, the batsman misses the flick.
Fuller in length on off, Buttler tries to hit it through the off side but gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
Ishant Sharma is back on.
Yes, he can! Poor from Hardik, he should have bowled this one also wide outside off but instead attacks the stumps. Buttler taps it towards mid-wicket and takes the single.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman. One ball to go, can Buttler take the single?
On the middle stump, Buttler works it through mid-wicket and runs two.
Anderson gets off strike! Length again, Anderson taps it towards mid off and goes for the single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Good length on middle, Anderson blocks it out.
Starts off with a ball down the leg side, James misses the flick.
FOUR! 14 from the last three balls, however, the good thing for India is Anderson will be on strike. A length ball on middle, Buttler pulls it through mid-wicket and the ball races away.
SIX! BANG! That has been pulled with disdain! Short and on middle, Buttler was expecting it perhaps as he is in position early. He pulls it right off the middle and into the stands for a biggie.
FOUR! Up and over! Buttler has activated the T20 mode. This is on a length around middle, Buttler lofts it over the bowler's head and it goes for a boundary.

Just over the fielder and a brace results. England have managed to avoid the follow-on. Shami bowls it on middle, it shapes away. Buttler tries to flick but closes the face of the bat early. It takes the leading edge and goes just over the leaping fielder at short covers.
On a length, this sticks off the surface. Buttler tries to drive it on the up but hits it uppishly just short of covers.
On middle, worked towards mid-wicket. Buttler does take the run.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball - but fails.
James Anderson is the last man in.

OUT! That is plumb! Fifer for Hardik Pandya. All the talks about why he is being selected have just been thrown out of the window. He has turned the game around in just 29 balls. Another delivery which is on the fuller side has done the trick for him. It swings back in late from around off, Broad from within his crease tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises the finger. Broad asks his partner about the review but Buttler asks him to keep walking. England need another 2 to avoid the follow-on, they have one wicket in hand.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Similar ball to the last one. Broad keeps it out.
No hat-trick but a good delivery. On a length and on the stumps, Broad defends it.
Stuart Broad walks out to the middle.

OUT! Maiden four-fer for Pandya in Tests! He is relishing the conditions out there. Wickets on consecutive balls for him. Lovely stuff again. He has really found his length and line today. Bowls it around off, just behind the fuller length. Once again it swings away. Rashid tries to defend inside the line. But the ball kisses the outside edge of the bat and settles into the mitts of Pant who is having a dream debut with the gloves. His fifth catch and the end now is nigh for England. Hat-trick ball coming up...
Keeps it just outside off. The ball seemed to have skid off the surface. Rashid gets his bat down in time to push it towards point. They cross over for a single.
Fuller on off stump. Rashid prods forward and keeps it out.
Banged in short. Rashid goes for pull but misses it completely. Pant collects.
FOUR! Wrong line from Shami. Angles this length ball a bit too much towards the batsman's pads. Rashid nudges it to the fine leg boundary for a four.
Back of a length this time  on off. Buttler stays in his crease and taps this towards the point region for a single

Bowls it very full on the off stump. Looking for some swing but gets none. Buttler plants his front foot forwards and drives it crisply. The ball beats mid off to his right and crosses the boundary ropes.
Adil Rashid comes in for a bat.

OUT! Snicko shows a spike and Woakes starts walking back. He takes a review along with him, and England are now in dire straits. This is excellent from Pandya. He says enough of the full ones and bangs in a short one. It is a well-directed one as well. It surprises Chris Woakes as he goes for the pull without keeping his eyes on the ball. It seems to have taken the glove and Rishabh Pant behind takes a jumping one-handed catch. The Indians appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Chris Woakes walks up to his partner and has a chat. He then goes for the review but the replays show there is an edge. Pandya now has a three-fer and the centurion of the last game walks back with a single digit score.

Woakes has been given caught behind! He goes for the review, not immediately though. Strange as a batsman most of the times knows whether he has hit it or not and had he not, he would have gone for it straightaway. Let's find out...
Good length on off, Chris defends it onto the ground.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! This is delightful! Full again by Pandya, no swing on offer, Woakes strokes it past covers and the ball races away.
FOUR! Streaky! Fuller in length on off, Woakes tries to drive but the ball takes the outside edge and goes through backward point for a boundary.
BEATEN! Pandya is breathing fire out there. He bowls the inswinger this time outside off. Woakes like JB goes for a drive with no foot movement and gets beaten.
Chris Woakes is the next batsman. Can he repeat what he did in the last match?

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Hardik Pandya is silencing his critics in some style. He gets his second and India are all over England now. This is another top nut. The outswinger on a fuller length around off, Bairstow tries to drive but his feet are rooted to the crease. The ball takes the edge and goes into the hands of Rahul at second slip who takes his third catch of the innings. The Indians are pumped up as they probably have the most destructive batsman in this English line-up. 329 looks farfetched now.
Too wide outside off, the batsman need not play at those.
The in-swinger this time, Jos tries to defend but the ball takes the inside edge and goes through square leg for a brace.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

Just short this time! The Indian bowlers are bowling brilliantly. Shami has been average throughout today but he has bowled two really good deliveries here. This is on a length around off, and it shapes away. Buttler tries to defend but the ball kisses the outside edge and falls just short of Kohli at third slip. He makes a good stop, saves a boundary.
Jos Butler comes in to bat next. He hasn't had a good series so far. Can he make amends today?

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! England have half the side back in the hut and they still trail by another 221 runs. Ben Stokes' poor form with the bat continues. Shami gets a wicket, and boy did he need that? He bends his back on this one and bowls it just behind the length on off. Stokes is squared up as he tries to block it and the ball takes the outside edge. It goes at a comfortable height to Rahul at second slip and he takes it without any doubt this time.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
FOUR! CLOBBERED! Hardik Pandya pays the price for over-pitching as Jonny smashes him through covers and that goes to the fence like a tracer bullet.

Errs in line. Tries to bowl the in-swinger and surprise the batsman with something different, however, the line is wrong. Bairstow tries to flick but gets in a tangle as he hits his pad with the bat. The keeper collects it with a dive.
Outside off, not fiddled with this time either.
Wide outside off, left alone.

Lovely stuff, excellent by Pandya. He has received so much criticism for his bowling but he is really doing well here. He shortens his length from the previous delivery though not a lot, just a little. Gets it to move away again, JB goes for the booming drive through the off side but gets beaten. The ball, luckily for him, whizzes past the outside edge.

EDGY FOUR! Pandya is really bowling well here. He bowls this very full and on off, it shapes away. Bairstow goes for the booming drive but the ball takes the outside edge and goes through gully for a boundary.
Shami strays this one on Bairstow's pads who flicks it to the man at deep fine leg for a single.
Beaten this time. This is a fuller delivery on off. Pitches and shapes away a bit. Batsman tries to defend but the ball misses the outside edge.
Back of a length angling on the off stump. Bairstow defends off the back foot.
Lands this on a fuller length around off. The ball pitches and nips in a bit. Takes the inner half of the bat and hits the inside part of his pads. It rolls down to the covers fielder for nothing.
A length ball on off stump. Bairstow drives it to mid off.
Starts the over with a quick and short delivery angled straight into Bairstow. He ducks under it.

NOT OUT! It's umpire's call and India retains the review! A very good one by the visiting side. Pandya steams in and bowls it fuller on middle, Stokes walks down the wicket and goes for the flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Hardik starts appealing, he actually is pleading as he falls over in doing so. The umpire shakes his head. Virat has a chat with his teammates and they go for the review. Replays roll in and it shows the ball to be clipping the off pole. Excellent decision in the end by the umpire.
A huge appeal for an LBW has been turned down. Stokes is the man in question and India have gone for the review. Pitching could be an issue here.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Back of a length on off, Bairstow guides it through point for a run.
Another outswinger on off, JB shoulders arms to it.
On off, Jonny blocks it out.
Better! On a length around off, this one shapes away. Jonny makes a good leave.
Swing again and a lot of it. The line though was not correct, way outside off, left alone. Wide has been signaled by the umpire, not something you see in Test matches.
An effort ball this. It jags back in after pitching outside the off stump and hits Ben on his inner thigh pad. No harm done in the end.
Good line this. Sticking to the off stump. Ben defends it with a straight bat.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

FOUR! Fine shot this. Its on a length around off, Stokes comes down the track to negate the swing and does well to hit it wide of the fielder at short square leg. The ball manages to touch the boundary just in time.
Full on the pads, Jonny misses it and gets hit on his pads. An appeal ensues but the bowler wasn't interested. One leg bye stolen.
Agonizingly close to the off pole but it should be counted as a great leave. A length ball around off, the ball holds its line and goes past the off pole as Bairstow leaves it alone.
FOUR! Not convincing but every run is handy. Short and outside off, Stokes slashes at it, he gets a thick outside edge through backward point and the ball races away.

BEAUTY! Almost gets his second in this over. Pandya lands it on a length and this time he gets it to come back in. Stokes tries to defend but does not account for the insward movement. The ball sneaks through the gap between bat and pad and goes to the keeper.
Outside off again, Stokes need not play at those.
Good length outside off, Stokes lets it be.
off the mark on the very first ball! A confident stroke there. Full and outside off, Stokes leans into it and times it through covers for a brace.
Ben Stokes comes out to bat.

OUT! This is what the big screen flashes and Root has been given his marching orders. The crowd is not happy and neither is Root as he shakes his head while walking off. The soft signal has surely played a big role in this being given out as it could have gone either way. India though won't mind as they have the talisman of the English batting line-up and that too cheaply. Hardik Pandya has delivered  straightaway. He bowls it on a back of a length around off, it pitches and straightens. Root goes back and tries to push the ball inside the line but it takes the outside edge and goes low towards Rahul at second slip. He seems to have taken it and starts celebrating. Root waits there. The umpires have a chat and then take it upstairs. The soft signal is OUT. Time for the replays and after several looks, it is ruled in favour of the visiting side. Really a 50-50 call as from one angle it looked like the ball had bounced off his fingers while from the other angle, it appeared to have touched the ground first. Anyway, the decision has been made and the Indians are celebrating. They are right on top now as England trail by another 243 runs.
Has that carried? Rahul certainly feels it has but Root is standing his ground as he thinks it didn't. The umpires have a look. They go upstairs and the soft signal is out. A huge moment in the game.
Hardik Pandya comes in for a spell.

Drinks! So, after a lousy start with the ball, the Men in Blue have managed to bring the game back in their corner with three quick wickets. The home team has their skipper, Joe Root, grinding out in the middle. The next hour is crucial for both the teams. Let's see who dominates.
Nice and tight in the corridor of uncertainty. Jonny presents the full face of the willow and defends it.
On middle and leg, Jonny fails to put bat to ball and gets hit on the pad.
Jags back in sharply this time. A shortish ball in line of the stumps, Bairstow looks to defend but is done by the bounce and movement.
Fullish just outside off, defended.
Better! Short of a length on off, Jonny gets to his toes and keeps it down.
Wide outside off, Bairstow flashes but misses.
The angle is a bit too much this time as Bumrah darts this into Root who uses his wrists nicely. Works it towards the deep square leg region for a brace.

Mohammed Shami is back on. He was wayward in his first spell, Kohli would be hoping for a better spell by him. Also, the two substitutes are off the field and Ashwin and Pujara are back on the field. With Ashwin coming back in, are we in for a double bowling change? Not sure though whether he can be given the ball immediately as he was out for quite a long time.
On a length just outside off. Bairstow, from his crease, opens the face of the bat and pushes it towards point. They cross over for a single.
A bit short this time but wide enough to allow Bairstow to shoulder his arms.

Oversteps. Bumrah may be trying to put in that extra efforts, goes over the line and delivers a No Ball. He digs it in short and Bairstow ducks under it. Bumrah needs to be more careful as the umpire signals No Ball.
Lands it on a length around the off stump. Bairstow pushes it towards point with a straight bat.
Just short of a length with the incoming angle. It pitches on middle and continues to cut in. Beats Bairstow and the ball thuds his thigh pad from the inside edge of the bat.
Ishant bowls it fuller and angling into the batsman. Bairstow flick it with the angle to deep fine leg. They cross for a single.
A length ball again on off, Bairstow fails to make a connection and gets hit high on his thigh pad.
On middle and leg, tucked to mid-wicket by Jonny.
On a length around off, played to point for no run.
Now, Ashwin is seen walking with the physio outside the fence and across the stadium. Still no concrete answers as to what is going on. Is he injured?
FOUR! Streaky but a boundary. Bairstow gets a fullish ball in line of the stumps and he gives it a whack. The timing is okay and as a result, it goes over Dhawan at short leg with his helmet on.

In-swinger on middle and off, Bairstow pushes at it with hard hands and gets it off the inner half of the bat. It goes to Jadeja at short square leg. It seems Indian bowlers have a specific plan for the big Bairstow.
Too straight and down the leg side, the batsman lets it be.
Root hangs back in the crease to this relatively full delivery on off. Gets his bat down just in time to push the ball to point.
A bit straighter from Bumrah. Root works it with the angle on the leg side. No run.
Wide of off and Root choose to leave this alone.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it in on a length. It pitches on off and straightens. The batsman beaten and is lucky that it did not take the edge of his bat.

Edged and falls short. A short of a length ball on off, pitches and nips away. Root looks to defend with a straight bat. The movement away gets the outside edge. But Root has done well to play it with soft hands and hence it bounces short of the man at second slip.
Ashwin is practicing in the indoor nets. He hasn't taken the field post Lunch. What is going on?
On a length outside off, Bairstow leaves it alone.

Ooh! Everything is happening for Ishant and India here. Another good ball around off, and it moves away just a tad after pitching. Bairstow does well to defend it with a full face of the bat. End of a successful over for  the visitors.
Wide down the leg side, No trouble at all for Bairstow.
A back of a length ball on the hips, Jonny looks to flick it through square leg but substitute Jadeja at short square leg is stationed for such a shot precisely.
The batsman offers no stroke and is wrapped on the pads.
Bouncer! Ishant welcomes the new man with a bumper who does well to evade it.
Jonny Bairstow is the new man in.

OUT! Not a nice way to get out but Pope will have to go. A bouncy delivery almost tickling the rib cage. Pope tried to work it fine but Sharma's ability to extract extra bounce off the pitch brought his downfall. The ball brushed his gloves and Pant took his third catch, this time by diving to his left. England are in a similar position as India, losing three after the opening pair put on a 50-run stand. This is a good passage of play for the visitors. Can they make further inroads in this session?
Ends the over with a ball outside off. Root lets Pant collect it.

Beaten! Peach from Ishant. Goes wide of the crease and angles it into Root. It pitches on a length on off stump. The angle forces Root to play at it. But the ball seams away on hitting the deck and that is enough to beat the outside edge of the English captain's bat.
Bumrah keeps it tight. Bowls it just shorter of a length on off. Root blocks it from his crease.
Keeps it outside off, Root lets it go past.

FOUR! Streaky. The English captain is riding his luck here. Ishant kept it full on off, the ball pitched and straightened. Found the outside edge of Root's bat but the ball went between the keeper and first slip. Did it carry? Rishabh Pant was seen moving towards the leg side as soon as Bumrah released the ball. Due to that, he was left wrong-footed when he had to move to his right to attempt that catch. He did try to get to the ball with a dive but was a little too late in doing so. Pujara at first slip also got wrong-footed as he was moving to his right. It sped past his left side to the fence.
Full on off, defended off the back foot by the batsman.
A bit shorter this time from Ishant but the line is same. Pope this time tucks it away into the mid-wicket region.
The inswing is still on offer. He lands it full and in line of the stumps. Pope drives to mid on with the swing.
A fuller ball on off stump, angling in. But is defend solidly by Pope.
Ishant lands it shorter this time. But also gives enough width to Root to punch it through covers. The fielder chases it down and keeps it down to three.
FOUR! Bad ball Ishant. He goes for the bumper to surprise the batsman maybe. But gets his line wrong and strays down leg. Root swivels and pulls it very fine down the leg side for boundary.
A length ball just outside off stump. Root comes forward and drives it straight to point. No run.
Short of a good length around off and Pope blocks it out. A maiden.

Peach, an absolute peach this one. Pope has no idea where and how it went through him, cutting him in half. A length ball pitching outside off. It comes in with Bumrah's natural angle and goes in between bat and pad and just over the middle stump. Not to forget, it was bowled at 142 kph. He is bowling with a lot of venom and rightly so!
A touch fuller in line of the stumps, driven to the on side for nothing.
Good stuff, Bumrah! Again good line targeting the off pole and keeping it on the just short of length area. Pope could only defend it, which he does nicely.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Nice tight lines from Bumrah. He is not allowing Pope to get any room. The length is on the money as well. Pope defends the length ball to the off side. I like this!
A bit shorter in length on off. Defended off the front foot, presenting the full face of the bat.

Big inswing on offer for Ishant. Keeps this full and angling into Root from off. Root tries to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. Indians appeal but umpire denies as it was clearly sliding down the leg.

The movement coming in is definitely troubling Pope. Ishant lands this just behind a length on off. The ball seams in. Pope tries to keep it out but the movement takes the inside edge on the bat and onto his thigh. Ishant is steaming in here.
Misses his line. Strays down leg and collected by Pant.
Well bowled again. A very full delivery on off, Pope looks to drive it straight. The ball pitches and seams away which takes the leading edge of Pope's bat. The ball rolls to point. No run.
Starts the over with a very full delivery angling in on off. Pope pushes it to mid on.
Gets behind the line of this one and manages to keep it out nicely. Just 2 came off this one. India have managed to get the run-rate down with those two blows.
Fullish, Pope pushes it to mid-wicket for nothing.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Jeez, some delivery this. He gets it to skid through again does Bumrah. A back of a length ball outside off. Pope looks to dab it but is beaten by some margin.
Full around off, driven to mid on for no run.

In the air... but safe! A short ball targeting Pope's grille who pulls it unconvincingly. The ball goes towards deep backward square leg and Sharma from fine leg runs to his left and keeps it down to two.
A bit shorter this time on off, Root stands tall and punches it to mid off for nothing.
Full on off, Root comes forward and blocks this easily with a full face of the bat.
Gets back to the line on off, Root defends solidly on the front foot.
Strays down the leg side. Root tries to flick but does not get any bat. Pant collects.

Very full angling on middle stump. Root tries to work it into the leg side. Closes the face of the bat a bit too early. The ball gets a leading edge but luckily for the batsman it rolls down to the bowler.
Ishant continues to hit that good length area on off stump. However, Pope gets a big stride forward and drives it past the right of mid off. The fielder chases it down and saves a single.
Ooh! Almost another here. Pope goes after the fullish delivery with hard hand. It takes the inside edge of the bat and goes through towards square leg. One run taken, not convincing though.
FOUR! Shot! The balance and the timing on this one is just immaculate. He gets to the full ball with a forward lunge and drives it through cover-point for a boundary.
Wide and full, driven to point for no run.
On a length around off, defended.
Outside off, left alone by Pope.
Promising youngster, Ollie Pope is the next man in.

OUT! Gone! Two in Two. Bumrah is the man this time. India back in the hunt! He again pushed it across Jennings who threw his bat at it with his feet glued to the crease. The ball kicks off and speeds off the surface, taking the outside edge of the hanging bat of Jennings. Pant makes no mistake in taking the second catch of his Test career. The Indians are ecstatic. Talk about Jennings' footwork. As Graeme Swann said during the break - 'You can finish tying his shoelaces yet his feet will remain where they were...' Big issue.
In comes Joe Root to the crease.

OUT! The dropped catch has not cost anything! Pujara will be a relieved man. Ishant gets rewarded for consistently bowling in the area of uncertainty. It pitches and then moves away, Cook has not looked comfortable against such deliveries and this time too he gets a faint outside edge. It goes straight into the hands of Pant who takes his first Test dismissal. A much-needed wicket for the Indians and that too a big one. Cook walks back after getting a start. This is also the 10th time he has been dismissed by Ishant Sharma. Also, this is his least favorite venue. Deadly combo.
Full ball on off, pushed away towards point.

DROPPED! How much will that cost India? They just cannot afford to drop chances. Ishant keeps it on a length on off stump. Cook comes forward to defend. The ball hits the surface and nips away ever so slightly. The movement takes the outside edge which carries easily to Pujara at First slip, who spills it. May be the diving keeper distracted him.
FOUR! Cook gets his first boundary after Lunch. Back of a length delivery on off. Cook guides towards the vacant third man region. Cook gets four more.
Ashwin is out of the field currently and Jadeja has come in as his replacement. Tactics or some rest?
Ishant is getting some good away movement. Lands it just outside off , pitches and moves further away. Left by Cook.
Length ball on off, from round the wicket. Cook comes forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Outside off again, this time Keaton lets it be.
Zip, bounce and carry, this delivery had everything except the edge. He bowled this around off and pushed it across. Jennings looks to cut but is late on it. He misses and Pant collects it easily.
Jennings is adamant to stay put in his crease, almost like his feet are glued. He chops the length ball to covers for nothing.
In line of the stumps, on short of a length. Jennings stays back and keeps it out.
Similar kind of delivery from Bumrah, Keaton happy to defend.
Back of a length ball around off, pushed to point.
Jasprit Bumrah to share the attack.
Ends the over with a full ball attacking the stumps. Cook stands tall and blocks it out with a straight bat.
Length ball outside off, Cook has nothing to do with it.

FOUR! Not totally in control but Cook will take it. Ishant goes wider and shorter this time. Cook throws his hands at it and gets it in the gap at cover-point. The ball races across and that is the first fifty-run opening stand for England in this series.
Tight bowling here from Ishant. He lands this one on a length and on off. Cook prods forward to defend solidly.
Keeps it on a length just wide of off. It hits the deck and moves away. Cook shoulders arms.
Starts well with a full pitch delivery on off. Cook comes forward and pushes it to mid off.

We are back for the afternoon session. Out comes the Indian team. They will dearly want to get some quick wickets. The English openers, Alastair Cook and Keaton Jennings, will resume. The former will be on strike. Ishant Sharma to start proceedings for the visitors. Here we go...
... Day 2, Session 2 ...

The hosts now trail by 283 and they would hope the current pair keeps on batting in a similar way. Also, they would wish for the sun to come out, just like yesterday, which can make the conditions a bit easy for batting. The Asian side, on the other hand, will try and bowl better after the break and get a few early scalps. Will the English side continue their dominance or will India come roaring back? Join us in a short while to find out.

End of an excellent morning session for England! First, it was their two premium bowlers who took two wickets each and kept India under 350. Then their openers, under testing conditions, not only head into the lunch break wicket-less but have also scored ever so fluently. They were also helped by the Indian bowlers who were very poor as they bowled too many short deliveries and paid the price for it.
Outside off on a length, left alone by KJ. THAT IS LUNCH ON DAY 2.

A bit shorter this time but the line remains the same. Cook will be happy to play this shot all day long. Bumrah fires it into Cook just back of a length. Cooks goes back and works it through the mid-wicket region. The fielder at square leg gives it a good chase and stops the ball from crossing the boundary. The batsmen run three.
Cook uses the angle well as he moves inside the line. Angling on a length. Cook tucks it into the leg side, towards mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Back of a length on off, Cook stands tall and pushes it towards point.
Bowls it down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. Does not get bat to ball and Pant collects it.
Bumrah from round the wicket, angles it in and lands it on a length around off. The ball pitches and moves away ever so slightly. Cook tries to get bat on ball, but is beaten by the away movement.
Change of ends for Jasprit Bumrah.
On the stumps, kept out. End of a tight over by Ashwin, not a lot of purchase for him though.
Flighted ball on off, KJ drives it to the man at covers.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On the shorter side, Jennings goes back and works it through mid-wicket and runs two.
The straighter one on middle, Jennings tries to defend but gets it off the inner half towards square leg.
In the air... but just wide! Ashwin tosses this up on off, it stops a touch on the batsman. Cook goes for the drive but hits it uppishly. Luckily it goes wide of short cover for a run.
Ravichandran Ashwin is into the attack.

Another short ball, poor from Shami. Jennings stands tall and punches it through cover-point. Dhawan there gives it a chase, fumbles but does not concede any extra run. Another expensive over by Shami. He has gone for 23 in his 4.

FOUR! Streaky again but England won't mind at all. Back of a length outside off, Jennings tries to defend but then the ball takes the outside edge and races to the third man fence. England off to a very good start here. They trail by another 293.
The lengths are good now but the line is a tad wide. Jennings leaves it.
Angles this one away from the batsman. Jennings shoulders arms to it.
Better! Shami should be consistently hitting these areas. On a length and around off, Jennings defends it onto the ground.
Again guilty of bowling too short! Easy for Jennings, he punches it through covers and takes two.
Fullish and outside off, Cook keeps his weight on the back leg and pushes it towards covers.

Bumrah oversteps and bowls a no ball, first of this Test match. A length ball in line of the stumps, Cook covers the line and blocks. Strange to see a bowler, known to be a shorter format specialist, overstep. If you remember, he bowled a big no ball in the Champions Trophy final and the rest is history.
Good length delivery on off, Cook defends it from the back foot.
FOUR! That's a cracking drive. Bumrah delivers it with a wobbly seam and lands it too full around off. Cook without taking his front foot too forward, drives it crisply through covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Michael Holding (on air) is not too pleased with the way the slip fielders are standing. They are too close to each other, too narrow and they might fail to understand whose catch it is. Fair point.
This one is delivered in the channel outside off, Cook has nothing to do with it.
Continues from 'round the wicket and angles in a length ball around off. It doesn't rise much and Cook somehow keeps it out safely from the back foot.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump. Another poor over by Jennings comes to an end.
FOUR! Easy-peasy! Shami has not got it right here. He bowls another half-tracker outside off, Jennings guides it through point and the ball races away.

Almost drags it on! Slightly short and closer to the off stump, Cook tries to cut but the shot is not on. He gets an inside edge which goes agonizingly close past the off pole, down to fine leg for a run.
Closer to the off pole from Shami this time, Cook gets behind the line and blocks it out.
FOUR! Well if you offer so much width, Cook will pounce onto it. He says thank you very much and slaps it through covers for a boundary.
OHHHH! Back of a length outside off, Cook pokes at it and gets beaten. Maybe a lapse of concentration there as you normally don't see Cook going after balls so far outside off.

Howzzat? The answer to that question is not out. On a length around off, this pitches and comes back in. Beats the defense of Jennings and hits him on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Bumrah indicates it is going down with the angle.
Bowls it on off, Jennings defends it.
Well bowled, well played and well ran! On the good length area and attacks the stumps, Cook taps it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
On the pads again, Cook misses the flick and gets hit on the pads.
Like that! Just ahead of a length on off, this one pitches and comes back in. Cook hops, is beaten for pace and gets hit on the thigh.
A little too straight, Cook hops and works it to mid-wicket. The Indian bowlers are a touch short, need to bowl it a little fuller.
A good delivery to end the over! Length on off, blocked. A maiden by Shami.
Nicely bowled! Lands it around off and gets this one to straighten. Jennings hangs his bat out and luckily for him he gets beaten.
Movement this time from outside off, Jennings though gets behind the line of the delivery and keeps it out.
Wide outside off again, KJ shoulders arms to it.
Again bowls it outside off, the ball this time though does not come in and Jennings makes a leave.
Starts this from outside off and gets it to come back in. Jennings though spots it and defends it back to the bowler.

Pacy again! Down the leg side though. Cook misses the flick and Pant behind the stumps fails to collect it cleanly. No run results though. This will be another test for the debutant. Apart from his batting, his keeping skills will be tested in England. It ain't straightforward in this part of the world as the ball wobbles a lot.
That was quick! 142 kph. On off and slightly fuller. Cook somehow gets his bat down in time and defends it towards mid off.
Angles it into the pads and Cook works it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length on off, Cook defends it.
Works it around the corner with the angle for a run.

FOUR! EDGY AGAIN! This was in the air for quite a while. Not sure why there was no one diving for it. Bumrah almost makes an immediate impact on his return. Back of a length on off, this one straightens. Takes the outside edge and goes between third slip and gully and into the third man fence.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl from the other end.

FOUR BYES! Wayward stuff from Shami! This is way down the leg side and swings away further. Cook misses the flick and Pant behind the stumps, dives but can't reach it. An over full of ooohhzz and aahhzzz.

In the air but just away! The change of angle almost does the trick for Shami. He comes around the wicket and bowls it very full on middle, it comes back in. Jennings tries to work it through the leg side but gets a soft leading edge back towards the bowler. Shami stretches his hands out but can't reach it. It rolls towards mid off and a run is taken.
On the pads again, not good by Shami. Needs to attack the off pole. This is too easy for Cook as he works it to fine leg for a run.
Wrong line, a touch too straight. Cook tucks it to mid-wicket.
That was quick! The pitch surely seems to have livened up here. This is down the leg side, Cook misses the flick and it rushes through to Pant who moves swiftly to his right and collects it.

EDGED AND FOUR! England are straightaway underway but this is an encouraging sign for the bowler. Shami bowls it a touch short on middle, this one angles away after pitching. Cook tries to defend but gets an outside edge which goes between gully and third slip and into the third man fence.
